newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northwest panel to oversee power restructure.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northwest panel to oversee power restructure.

text.p: The governors of Idaho, Montana, Oregon and Washington have appointed a four-member panel to oversee the implementation of electricity industry restructuring as proposed in a recent report.
The plans were submitted to the governors Thursday by a steering committee representing utilities, policy makers and consumers.
The governors asked the new panel, to be called the Northwest Energy Review Transition Board, to present a draft plan for implementing restructuring by mid-February.
- Establishment of an independent transmission system
- Voluntary support for energy conservation, renewable power and public policy programs
- Local utility control over local energy decisions
- Continued restoration of salmon and steelhead runs
- Division of Bonneville Power Administration, the federal agency which markets power produced at federal dams in the Northwest, into separate transmission and marketing units.
